cognitive_classification.crux_move: Compute net rotation angle θ = +45° + 180° - 270° = -45° from initial West bearing to determine South-West

source_question.stem: A person is facing West. They turn 45° clockwise, then 180° clockwise, and finally 270° anti-clockwise. Which direction are they facing now?

answer.crux_move_ref: Compute net rotation angle θ = +45° + 180° - 270° = -45° from initial West bearing to determine South-West

hint_ladder.hint1_conceptual_nudge: Set up a signed algebraic sum where clockwise turns are positive (+45°, +180°) and anti-clockwise turns are negative (-270°).
hint_ladder.hint2_tactical_step: Calculate the net angle from the signed sum: 45° + 180° - 270° = -45°. Then determine which direction is 45° anti-clockwise from West.

solution.derivation:
1. Net rotation = (+45°) + (+180°) + (-270°) = +225° - 270° = -45°.
2. A negative rotation corresponds to an anti-clockwise turn of 45°.
3. Turning 45° anti-clockwise from West points directly between South and West, which is South-West (Option D).

independent_check.verification: Trace step by step: West (180°) + 45° CW = 225° (NW). 225° + 180° CW = 405° = 45° (NE). 45° - 270° CCW = -225° = +135° (South-West). Matches Option D uniquely.

distractor_analysis.A: Omitted the initial 45° clockwise turn, rotating 180° - 270° = -90° from West to South.
distractor_analysis.B: Rotated 45° clockwise from West to North-West instead of net anti-clockwise.
distractor_analysis.C: Assumed complete cancellation to original direction.

html_representation:
D1 APPLY Unit: Direction Sense

A person is facing West. They turn 45° clockwise, then 180° clockwise, and finally 270° anti-clockwise. Which direction are they facing now?

Set up a signed algebraic sum where clockwise turns are positive (+45°, +180°) and anti-clockwise turns are negative (-270°).

Calculate the net angle from the signed sum: 45° + 180° - 270° = -45°. Then determine which direction is 45° anti-clockwise from West.

Show Complete Solution

1. Net rotation = (+45°) + (+180°) + (-270°) = +225° - 270° = -45°.

2. A negative rotation corresponds to an anti-clockwise turn of 45°.

3. Turning 45° anti-clockwise from West points directly between South and West, which is South-West (Option D).
